metrics.title: Task Completion Rate
metrics.description: Can users actually accomplish what they came to do? The foundational usability metric.
metrics.whyItMatters: A <70% task completion rate is a hard signal of UX failure. This is the first number executives should ask for.

metrics.title: Time on Task
metrics.description: How long does it take to complete a critical flow? Shorter = more efficient design.
metrics.whyItMatters: Baseline comparison before/after redesigns. Quantifies efficiency gains in seconds and dollars.

metrics.title: Error Rate
metrics.description: How often do users make recoverable or unrecoverable mistakes in key flows?
metrics.whyItMatters: High error rates mean higher support costs. Reducing errors = reducing ticket volume.

metrics.title: Funnel Drop-off
metrics.description: Where are users abandoning key flows? Which step has the highest exit rate?
metrics.whyItMatters: Identifies exactly where UX debt lives. Prioritises redesign effort by business impact.

metrics.title: Feature Adoption Rate
metrics.description: Are shipped features actually being used? What % of eligible users engage within 30 days?
metrics.whyItMatters: Tells us if what we shipped mattered. Low adoption = the feature missed the user need.

metrics.title: Page-level Engagement
metrics.description: Which screens get traffic? Which are dead ends that nobody reaches?
metrics.whyItMatters: Navigation design validation. High traffic to wrong screens signals IA problems.

metrics.title: NPS / CSAT
metrics.description: Periodic user satisfaction signals tied to product interactions.
metrics.whyItMatters: Executive-facing satisfaction number. Links UX investment to user sentiment over time.

metrics.title: SUS Score (Live Baseline)
metrics.description: System Usability Scale as an ongoing benchmark — not just from discrete test sessions.
metrics.whyItMatters: Standardised, comparable across quarters and against industry benchmarks (68 = industry average).

insights.title: Composer drop-off is improving
insights.body: Post creation funnel completion rose 10 points over four months after the simplified media picker shipped in Feed.

insights.title: DM recipient search is the top friction point
insights.body: 18% exit rate at recipient selection — highest step in the start-DM funnel. Matches usability findings from March research.

insights.title: Spark AI adoption outpacing launch targets
insights.body: 35% adoption within 28 days among eligible creators — 8 points above the 30-day goal set at launch.

insights.title: Profile settings bounce rate needs attention
insights.body: 34% bounce suggests users arrive from deep links but cannot complete account tasks without hunting for controls.
